patch.summary:
Choose LiveChat only if your buying job matches “Established live chat from Text — Starter $19, Team $49, Business $79, Enterprise $52 per ” rather than Zendesk Suite's shape. Choose Zendesk Suite only if your buying job matches “Enterprise helpdesk and Suite omnichannel — Support Team from $19/agent/mo annual; Suite T” rather than LiveChat's shape. Workflow advantage: LiveChat leans live-chat-support; Zendesk Suite leans helpdesk-ticketing, omnichannel-support. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: LiveChat is Established live chat from Text — Starter $19, Team $49, Business $79, Enterprise $52 per person/mo annual. Primary live-chat; CS secondary.; Zendesk Suite is Enterprise helpdesk and Suite omnichannel — Support Team from $19/agent/mo annual; Suite Team $55, Suite Pro $115..
- Company-size focus: LiveChat (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Zendesk Suite (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: LiveChat-leaning live-chat-support vs Zendesk Suite-leaning helpdesk-ticketing, omnichannel-support, ai-customer-service.
- Researched limits: LiveChat — ChatBot, HelpDesk, and KnowledgeBase are separate Text suite purchases; Zendesk Suite — Suite Pro at $115/agent/mo annual is expensive for SMB teams.

Limitations — LiveChat: ChatBot, HelpDesk, and KnowledgeBase are separate Text suite purchases; No free plan — trial-only entry; Zendesk Suite: Suite Pro at $115/agent/mo annual is expensive for SMB teams; Zendesk Sell (CRM) is a separate product — do not conflate slugs.
